name: Rocket Fuel - (1g) Live Resin - Banana Daddy
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, straight from the jar. Rocket Fuel Banana Daddy live resin delivers 1 gram of full-spectrum concentrate, extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with — bold, flavorful, and made for dabbing.

Banana Daddy brings a rich, tropical-sweet profile: ripe banana and creamy fruit notes up front, rounded out by a smooth, subtly gassy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect than standard extracts — potent, aromatic, and built for concentrate lovers.

Why you'll love it:

1G live resin — fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Banana Daddy flavor — ripe banana and cream with a smooth, gassy finish
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Banana Daddy is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
